title: Mixed Event — Connect Hearts Message — Episode1 Work Shadowing Excitement

meta.Event Outline: The second-years at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy are assigned a work shadowing program. Interested in learning about making fun memories for visitors, Saki, Emu and Shiho choose to visit an event planning company.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhumm♪
Now I just have to underline the important parts with my marker, and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm done! Hehe. It's all set now♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, Saki, your notebook looks so cute, colorful and wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I got these new markers the other day and I really wanted to test them out♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's good that each theme is color coordinated, but... What's with all the doodles?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, they're not doodles!
They're illustrations that are going to help me remember everything!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sure, sure.
Anyway, isn't it almost time for our long homerooms?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
We're gonna talk about the work research shadowing program today, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! We get to visit a company, talk to its employees and get hands-on work experience!
I'm so excited☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll see you guys later!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See you!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, now that you're all in your seats, let's begin our long homeroom.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: As we discussed earlier this morning, today you'll be deciding which companies you'll all be visiting for the work shadowing program.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I'll pass out lists detailing the companies that have agreed to work with us. Please mark which you'd like to visit and hand them forward.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wonder which companies signed up...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Isn't this the apparel brand with a shop inside the department store by the station? Does that mean we'll get to ask the employees about fashion stuff?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(And this is that snack company!
I'd love to see their factory! I bet it'd be so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Hmm... So many good choices...
I can't decide...)

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: Sorry, can we ask our friends to see what they think first?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Of course.
But be careful not to be too much of a bother to the other classes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(We can ask our friends...?!
Then...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shiho, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Have you made your choice yet?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Not yet...
Also, keep it down, you two.
What happened to not bothering the other classes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We gotta be as quiet as mice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you know which company you wanna visit, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I wanna visit this event planning company!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Event planning company?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's called “HeartUp Creation”!
They plan and run stage performances, town-revitalization stamp rallies and all sorts of other events!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, there's a company like that on this list?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Planning events sounds really fun...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, right☆ Also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think I'll be able to learn a lot about how to come up with ideas that guests will find fun and exciting, and how to make them a reality!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When you put it that way, this seems like the perfect choice for you, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(An event planning company...!
I wonder what other events they plan.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Oh, the printout gives more details!
Let's see...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, this cosmetics expo!
I've been to it before!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you have?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I even got to have a professional makeup artist use some brand-new products on me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So this is the company that put that whole thing together.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I remember having so much fun. I bought some really cute makeup and got a bunch more for free...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I've never thought about how events like that actually get set up...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I was totally blown away by how amazing professional makeup artists are, and the event was so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Giving people the opportunity to have fun like that, and make unforgettable memories, must be really great...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've made my choice!
I'm also gonna visit HeartUp Creation!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really! I wanna learn more about how you actually plan and run big events!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, if you haven't picked anything else, you should join us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, me too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I know it'll be super fun if all three of us go together♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I mean, take a look here!
They even run stage events and shows at malls and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We might perform in places like this in the future, so we can ask them all about those kinds of events!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, I hadn't made up my mind yet. So I'll go with that one, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we can't just go over and fool around. We need to take this visit seriously. Remember, we have to turn in a report at the end.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Shiho's got her serious face on like always!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to learn more about planning events with you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me neither! I wish it was the day of our visit already♪
